card.name: Herbal formula names in Chinese medicine
card.fires_on: Ampersands, brackets and punctuation inside or right after herbal formula names (e.g. 'persica & rhubarb combination (tao ren...') in traditional Chinese medicine text. It also fires on pieces of the herb and formula names themselves.

modes.label: Ampersand in formula names
modes.description: The '&' joining two herb names in a named formula.

modes.label: Punctuation after herb names
modes.description: An opening bracket or separator after an herb or formula name, before its pinyin name or the next herb.

modes.label: Partway through herb names
modes.description: Pieces of herb or pinyin formula names.

card.writes: It slightly favors Gamma/Γ tokens, which is not a clear match to the text; the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the joining symbols and brackets in Chinese herbal formula names like 'persica & rhubarb combination'.
